affected_callers: effect corpus generators and paired experiment runner

acceptance_criteria.condition: Normal Level 1/2 development automatically performs retirement cleanup and synchronizes stale descriptions without an explicit cleanup request.
A held-out cleanup corpus catches obsolete-path, duplicate, dynamic-retention, and documentation-drift mistakes that public tests alone can miss.
Applicable development/runtime instrumentation is bounded, redacted, lifecycle-aware, and mechanically validated; Level 0 emits no events.
The complete package remains valid and all existing regressions pass.

invariants: A fitting existing owner is reused instead of creating a competing implementation.
Confirmed obsolete paths are removed only after consumer and dynamic-lookup evidence; retained paths have a named consumer and removal condition.
Public green tests do not substitute for hidden cleanup contracts.
Instrumentation never contains secrets, raw payloads, personal data, source text, or unbounded user labels.
This deterministic corpus and telemetry checker do not establish a model-wide capability improvement without a completed blinded paired experiment.

remove: single-argument assumptions in cleanup corpus generation

retain.consumer: existing V9 decision/repair corpus tests and runner
retain.removal_condition: Only remove when the V9 protocol is explicitly superseded.
retain.observability: V9 manifest tree hashes and existing corpus tests

documentation_synchronization.evidence: Contract tests and package validator passed.

instrumentation.redaction_and_cardinality: validate_development_events.py rejects sensitive/unbounded keys, permits bounded snake_case labels, and rejects duplicate logical transitions.

safeguards.name: hidden cleanup contract
safeguards.rationale: Hidden tests verify both current behavior and retirement hygiene, including traps where public tests pass.

safeguards.name: bounded redacted event validator
safeguards.rationale: The standard-library checker enforces schema, level thresholds, lifecycle order, duplicate prevention, and forbidden fields.

safeguards.name: no new dependency
safeguards.rationale: Corpus and event validation use the existing Python standard library and existing test runner.

design_boundary.rationale: SKILL.md owns policy; generator, checker, fixtures, and tests are separate bounded enforcement surfaces.

dependency_audit.rationale: No dependency or import edge was added.

extension_decision.rationale: No runtime extension point was introduced.

data_ownership.rationale: Only deterministic fixture and event-schema data changed.

error_model.rationale: Invalid or incomplete event streams and hidden cleanup failures return non-zero or failing tests.

contract_evolution.rationale: Existing V9 profile remains unchanged; cleanup is an explicit additive profile.

operational_budget.rationale: Event validation bounds labels and lifecycle volume; runtime thresholds remain project-owned.

threat_boundary.rationale: Sensitive and user-controlled telemetry fields are rejected.

delivery_lifecycle.rationale: The package change is verified as one reviewable atomic scope.

data_migration.rationale: No schema or persistent application data changed.

configuration_secrets.rationale: No runtime configuration or credential path changed.

operational_knowledge.rationale: README and effect-evaluation reference document cleanup corpus and event validation commands.

reproducibility.rationale: Corpus manifest/tree hashes and deterministic tests reproduce the same split.
